s10.old: - Multi-layer R scraper for congress.gov using chromote (to bypass 403), user-agent rotation (later replaced by one consistent `CHROME_UA`, Chrome 148), randomized back-off and `future`/`future.apply` parallelism. Switch variable = the MEMBER (`original-cosponsor` value in an advanced-search query), not page number. Purpose: legislative activity (insurance/data-privacy/financial-services bills) per member across congresses 119/118/117/116.
s10.why: "later replaced by one consistent CHROME_UA" is time

s10.old: - **Outputs:** one workbook `Moneyball_Legislative_Score_<ts>.xlsx`, tabs `Legislative Score - Raw` (138 cols: Name, District/State, 17x8; row 2 = exact Weight row; headers/weights embedded verbatim from "Moneyball Main Version - Presentation.xlsx", python-verified byte-exact; `LEGIS_HEADERS`/`WEIGHTS` truncated to 138, previously 143 with 5 committee/leadership/caucus cols) + `All Interactions` + `Sponsor` / `Original Co-sponsor` / `Co-sponsor`. Per-section col 6 "Success Rate" = `round(mean(SponsorSuccess, OrigCosponsorSuccess),1)` on displayed rates (~3/9129 cells differ 0.1 by R half-to-even vs Excel half-up). District/State via `get_roster_meta_119()` (sen -> state; rep -> "Congressional District N (119th Congress), <State>"). Date = Congress only. Regeneration is OFFLINE-FAST via the SKIP_SCRAPE path once 51/51 passes are cached.

- **Query variants:** disk (older) = examination/supervision/CTR/SAR terms, `original-cosponsor`, 3 subjects; pasted = credit union capital terms (supplement/secondary/subordinated debt/PCA), `sponsor`, 4 subjects (+Housing); later a single phrase "Credit Card Competition Act". Diff the URL block before overwriting; user iterates by swapping `raw_url_parts`.
s10.why: "later a single phrase" is time (a later query variant)

s10.old: - **Outputs:** `cu_press_releases_scored.xlsx` (Scored Releases, Member Summary, Member x Category (net), Member x Category (count), Category Detail, Coverage, Member x Category (graded net), Coalition Members, Coalition Profiles; "Net by Category" tab first) + `cu_press_releases_scored.csv` + `cu_press_releases_category_scores.csv` + standalone `cu_net_scores_by_category.xlsx` ("Net by Category": Member, State, District ("Senate" / "At-Large" / number), 20 categories each with a `(n)` volume twin, Cumulative Net, Total Releases, Sum of Category Nets = 46 cols) + `all_press_release_index.csv`. `MEMBER_FILTER` = the user's 537-name list verbatim (`apply_member_filter()` rewrites `members$member` to the list spelling, keeps `roster_name`; `NICK_EQUIV`, `FILTER_NAME_OVERRIDES`; 537/537 matched). `safe_write()` timestamp fallback. `regen_outputs_offline.R` re-runs Stage 5 + outputs from checkpoints (excludes committees).
s10.why: "the list spelling" is the user's 537-name MEMBER_FILTER list named in the same sentence, not a list in the note

s10.old: - **`cu_text_collector.R`:** parse-bound problem (~62ms/page = ~16 pages/s/core; later ~30ms typical) solved by sharding members across N worker processes, each with an async libcurl multi pool (HTTP/2, multiplex), reusing `extract_release` (sourced with `CU_PR_NO_AUTORUN=1`) and writing the same `pr_checkpoints/fulltext/<bg>.rds` (url,title_detail,date_detail,body). Shards balanced by URL count via `collector_plan.rds` (greedy, deterministic, auto-unlinked at end). Fresh `new_pool()` per chunk (`CHUNK=1500`; a persistent pool crashes past ~3-4k transfers on Windows) with `rm(pool);gc(FALSE)`. Retries only transient (libcurl `fail` + 5xx); 4xx and empty-200 are permanent `miss`. Gentle recovery (<=3 passes, `total_con=8 host_con=2 robust=TRUE`, `forbid_reuse`, 5s cool-down) then chromote 403 lane (own Chrome per worker, `tc_js_fetch` polls body.innerText until >400 chars and stable, ~3.2s max; bounded by chromote `default_timeout`, not `setTimeLimit`; 0.5 s/url). `TC_CHROMOTE` gate with log line `[shard N] chromote gate: enabled=… | M blocked(403) urls queued`; `Sys.unsetenv("CU_PR_NO_CHROMOTE")` unless `CU_TC_NO_CHROMOTE` set. Orchestrator reads `.hb`/`.done` sentinels (written via `writeLines`, `write_hb()` every 200 bodies / 10 chromote urls), 20-min idle guard on body progress, per-shard watchdog (`collector_shard_i.pid`, `kill_shard`/`spawn_shard`, `taskkill /F /T /PID`), writes `collector_residual.csv`, `CU_TC_CAP` stratified collection (always fetch `TOPIC_CORE_RX` titles; `read_index` carries title). Measured: 6 cores ~47min, 8 ~36min; real run ~30min @6 cores; RAM ~450MB/worker (6 procs ~3GB). Coverage 254,477/293,935 = 86.6% before fixes, ~97-98% projected after (~5.1k genuine 404). Self-locates via `--file=`.
The narrative of each audit round lives in [[2026-06-feature-congress-r-scrapers]]; this catalogue keeps the code-level facts a maintainer needs next to the code root.
s10.why: "next to the code root" means beside the code on disk, not a place in the note
